parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
A person who has a wound to their skin may experience pain. Opioid drugs can be taken to relieve the pain.

Opioid receptors are located in the presynaptic membrane of a cholinergic synapse.

Fig. 6.1 shows the action of an opioid drug on the presynaptic membrane.

{{figure:figure_6_1.webp}}

Fig. 6.1

Explain how the action of an opioid drug on the presynaptic membrane can prevent the generation of pain impulses in the postsynaptic neurone.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem: Spinal reflexes help the body to respond very quickly to potentially dangerous situations that could cause injury.
parts.text: State **two** features of a spinal reflex, **other than** being fast.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
Sensory and motor neurones are involved in a spinal reflex.

State the location of the cell body of a sensory neurone **and** a motor neurone.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Describe the function in a spinal reflex of a sensory neurone **and** a motor neurone.
